title: La Cava Experience - Explore the Spirits of La Cava del Tequila | Walt Disney World Resort
body_text: La Cava Experience Located in World Showcase at EPCOT With a certified Tequila Ambassador as your host, learn the history and sample the tastes of the quintessentially Mexican spirit. ¡Salud! Dining Events Dining Plan Meals Not Accepted Check Availability Valid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type. Explore the Spirits of La Cava del TequilaEmbark on a magical journey to the region of Mexico where tequila was born. This experience—rich in culture and tradition—is a showcase for some of the finest tequila in the world.A certified Tequila Ambassador guides you through a selection of rare and unique agave spirits. Each spirit is paired with a flavor meant to enhance its essence. Some tequilas are exclusive to La Cava Experience and are not available anywhere else in the world.If you are looking to enhance and broaden your agave spirits knowledge, your adventure awaits!Know Before You GoLocationThis tasting experience takes place at La Hacienda de San Angel, located in EPCOT.PriceThe cost of this experience is $180 per person, plus tax. Gratuity is included.Third-party payments are not accepted. The name on the credit card must be the same as one of the individuals on the dining reservation. If applying multiple payments, at least one credit card payment must match the last name of one of the individuals on the dining reservation.ReservationsAdvance reservations are highly recommended. Learn when advance reservations can be made.While same-day reservations are not available online, please check for same-day availability at La Cava del Tequila’s host stand.Theme Park Reservation RequiredValid admission required. A theme park reservation may be required based on admission type.CancellationsYou must cancel at least one day prior to your reservation to avoid a per-person cancellation fee. If you fail to cancel with sufficient notice or don't show up for your reservation, the credit card provided at the time of reservation will automatically be charged $50 per person. Restaurants offering advance reservations do not allow modifications within 2 hours of the reservation time.AccessibilityThe tasting takes place at tables that are accessible by ECV and wheelchair. If a member of your party requires special mobility accommodations, please contact La Cava del Tequila at lacava@palmasrestaurants.com.Age RequirementGuests must be 21 years of age or older to participate in this experience. Please bring a valid form of identification to verify your age.Food and Special Dietary RequestsThe experience includes chips and guacamole, but it does not include a full meal.Please communicate any allergies or dietary restrictions to the team at La Cava del Tequila at lacava@palmasrestaurants.com. In addition, inform the Disney Cast Member, server, chef or manager on duty of any dietary restrictions when arriving at the dining location. Walt Disney World Resort uses reasonable efforts in our sourcing, preparation and handling procedures to avoid the introduction of the named allergens into allergy-friendly menu choices. While we take steps to prevent cross-contact, we do not have separate allergy-friendly kitchens and are unable to guarantee that a menu item is completely free of allergens. Allergy-friendly offerings are reliant on supplier ingredient labels. We cannot guarantee the accuracy of the contents of each food item. Allergen advisory statements (e.g., “may contain") are not regulated and therefore not taken into consideration when developing allergy-friendly meals. It is ultimately our Guests' discretion to make an informed choice based upon their individual dietary needs.Kosher meals are not available at this location.Subject to ChangeMenu items, pricing and hours are subject to change without notice.ModificationsThis restaurant has a modifications policy. The credit card provided at the time of reservation will automatically be charged a per-person fee if you fail to modify in accordance with the policy and then need to cancel. Policy details will be available when you make your reservation and in your confirmation email.
